findings.title: Bilingual Engine Unscoped QuerySelector Crash (app.js:617)
findings.description: Line 617 in app.js uses $$('.story-specs-table .spec-entry') without scoping to #story. It matches 8 elements (4 in #story and 4 in #location) while specPairs only has 4 entries. At index 4, specPairs[4][0] throws 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 0)', crashing setLanguage on page load and blocking all translations.
findings.reproduction: Run createInstance(false) or load index.html in any standard browser and observe console error on DOMContentLoaded.

findings.title: Video Audio Toggle Button Text / Action Inversion
findings.description: When video is muted (silent), button text displays '[ Tắt Âm ]' (Tắt Âm / Mute) instead of action to Unmute/Bật Âm Thanh. When video is unmuted, button displays '[ Bật Âm Thanh ]' / '[ Sound On ]'.

findings.title: Modal Drawer Incomplete Translation On Mid-Session Language Switch
findings.description: When switching language while Room Explorer Modal is open, the following elements are not dynamically refreshed: modalCategoryTitle remained VI, modalCategoryLevel remained VI, modalRoomKeysStrip 'All' tab remained VI, modalGalleryPhotoCount remained VI
